bgp_status.failed_title: Failed to start BGP speaker — check settings
bgp_status.pending_body: Local ASN, Router ID, BGP port, or local address was changed. The running BGP session won't use the new value until you apply it.
language.label: Language
app.title: wdbgp
app.subtitle: Admin Panel
login.rate_limit: Too many login attempts. Please try again later.
settings.filter_allow_hint: Allow specific CIDR prefixes or single IP addresses. One per line. Empty = allow all.
settings.filter_deny_hint: Deny specific CIDR prefixes or single IP addresses. One per line. Subtracts from allowed prefixes.
settings.metrics_enabled_hint: Record historical data for dashboard charts (user counts, feed prefix counts).
settings.metrics_history_days_hint: Number of days of historical data to keep. Older data is automatically purged.
settings.purge_metrics_hint: Delete all historical metrics data. Charts on the dashboard will become empty.
settings.env_override_hint: This setting is controlled by an environment variable and cannot be changed here.
settings.env_only_hint: This setting can only be set via its environment variable and requires a restart to take effect — it cannot be changed from the UI.
settings.unsaved_confirm: You have unsaved changes. Discard them?
settings.default_language_hint: Default language for the admin panel interface.
settings.admin_cookie_secure_hint: Send the admin session cookie only over HTTPS (auto = enabled when HTTPS is used).
settings.trust_proxy_headers_hint: Trust X-Forwarded-For and similar headers from reverse proxies.
settings.security_headers_hint: Send HSTS, X-Frame-Options, and other security-related HTTP headers.
settings.default_web_auth_hint: Default authentication mode for new web users (network = IP-based, login = password, both = IP + password, any = IP or password).
settings.status_allowed_hint: Comma-separated CIDR ranges allowed to access the status API endpoint without authentication.
settings.status_token_hint: Token required to access the status API endpoint.
settings.adapter_backup_dir_hint: Directory where adapter backup archives are stored.
settings.adapter_backup_max_hint: Maximum number of backup copies to keep per adapter.
settings.rate_limit_login_hint: Number of login requests allowed within the rate limit window.
settings.rate_limit_admin_hint: Number of admin API requests allowed within the rate limit window.
settings.log_level_hint: Minimum log level for messages written to stderr.
settings.log_format_hint: Output format for log messages (text or JSON).
settings.sync_interval_hint: Interval in seconds between feed synchronization runs.
settings.js_timeout_hint: Maximum execution time in milliseconds for a JavaScript snippet.
settings.js_max_source_hint: Maximum size in bytes of the JavaScript source code.
settings.js_max_response_hint: Maximum size in bytes of a single JavaScript response chunk.
settings.js_max_total_hint: Maximum total bytes a single JavaScript execution can produce.
settings.js_max_entries_hint: Maximum number of data entries a JavaScript execution may yield.
settings.js_max_requests_hint: Maximum number of HTTP requests a JavaScript execution can make.
settings.js_max_call_stack_hint: Maximum call stack depth for JavaScript execution.
settings.bgp_port_hint: TCP port number on which the BGP listener binds.
settings.bgp_hold_time_hint: Hold time proposed to peers (RFC 4271); each session uses the lower of the two sides. 3–65535, default 90.
settings.local_asn_hint: Autonomous System Number used for this BGP speaker.
settings.router_id_hint: Router ID in IPv4 dotted-quad format (e.g., 192.0.2.1).
settings.local_address_v4_hint: IPv4 address the BGP speaker uses as its local address.
settings.local_address_v6_hint: IPv6 address the BGP speaker uses as its local address.
settings.host_hint: IP address or hostname the HTTP server listens on.
settings.port_hint: TCP port number the HTTP server listens on.
settings.password_input_hint: Enter new value to change. Leave empty to keep current.
settings.db_path_hint: Path to the SQLite database file.
settings.session_secret_hint: Secret key for encrypting session cookies.
settings.auto_restore_enabled_hint: Automatically restore database from backup on version mismatch.
settings.backup_enabled_hint: Create automatic database backups before migrations.
settings.active_dial_hint: Server initiates BGP connections to peers (active dialing). Turn off for passive-only mode.
settings.allow_dynamic_peers_hint: Accept BGP connections from any IP (0.0.0.0/0 and ::/0).
settings.dynamic_peer_md5_match_hint: Authenticate dynamic peers by matching a real TCP MD5 signature via NFQUEUE, instead of ASN only. Requires a matching kernel/NFQUEUE setup outside this app (see the dynamic peer MD5 setup guide); takes effect on restart.
settings.dynamic_peer_md5_queue_num_hint: NFQUEUE number the external redirect rule feeds and this process consumes. Must match the rule's queue number. Takes effect on restart.
settings.require_password_for_non_unique: Force BGP MD5 password when multiple peers share the same IP address with different ASNs.

adapters.name: Name
adapters.source_hint: JavaScript function that parses feed data into catalog entries.
adapters.no_selection: Select an adapter from the list or add a new one.
adapters.fork_warning: This is a built-in adapter. Editing will create an editable copy. Built-in automatic updates will no longer apply to this copy.
adapters.review_needed: Review needed — original built-in was updated
adapters.acknowledged: Review acknowledged. Adapter marked as up-to-date.
adapters.builtin_readonly: Built-in adapters are read-only. Fork to create an editable copy.
feeds.title: Feeds
feeds.name: Name
feeds.url_hint: URL to download feed data from.
feeds.adapter_hint: Adapter that parses this feed's data.
feeds.allowed_hosts_hint: Comma-separated list of hosts the adapter is allowed to access.
feeds.restrict_hosts_hint: Restrict adapter HTTP requests to allowed hosts only.
feeds.no_selection: Select a feed from the list or add a new one.
feeds.sync_started: Sync started — running in the background.
feeds.data_hint: Custom JSON data passed to the adapter.
feeds.sync_interval_hint: Seconds between automatic syncs. 0 means use global interval.
feeds.assign_mode_hint: Optionally assign this feed to a catalog mode. Feeds must be assigned to a mode to be synced.
modes.title: Catalog Modes
modes.name: Name
modes.name_hint: Display name for this catalog mode.
modes.enabled_hint: Enable or disable this catalog mode.
modes.no_feeds_assigned: No feeds assigned to this mode.
modes.role_hint: Excluded feeds subtract their prefixes from this mode.
modes.delete_confirm: Delete this catalog mode? Users assigned to it will be moved to the default mode.
modes.no_selection: Select a mode from the list or add a new one.
modes.feeds_hint: Select which feeds belong to this catalog mode.
communities.reset_confirm: Delete all communities for this mode and regenerate from scratch?
communities.no_data: No catalog data yet. Sync feeds to generate communities.
communities.duplicate: Duplicate community value {value}. Each community number must be unique within a mode.
communities.title: Communities
communities.unsaved_confirm: You have unsaved changes. Discard them?
communities.none: No community data available. Assign feeds to this mode and sync them first.
users.title: Users
users.name: Name
users.peer_ip_hint: BGP peer IP address. Use 0.0.0.0 or :: for dynamic peers.
users.peer_asn_hint: Autonomous System Number of the BGP peer.
users.next_hop_hint: Optional. Override the next-hop IP in announced routes.
users.bgp_password_hint: MD5 authentication password for the BGP session. Leave empty to keep current.
users.filter_allow_hint: CIDR prefixes or single IPs the user is allowed to receive. One per line. Empty = allow all.
users.filter_deny_hint: CIDR prefixes or single IPs denied to the user. One per line. Subtracts from allowed.
users.bgp_password_enabled_hint: Enable MD5 authentication for this BGP peer.
users.bgp_password_unchanged_hint: Leave empty to keep current password. Type a new one to change.
users.dynamic_peer_hint: Use wildcard IP (0.0.0.0 or ::) to accept connections from any peer with this ASN.
users.web_auth_hint: Authentication mode for the user's web page.
users.enabled_hint: Enable or disable this BGP peer.
users.active_dial_hint: Server initiates the BGP connection to the peer.
users.catalog_mode_hint: Catalog mode assigned to this user.
users.networks_hint: CIDR prefixes for web auth (one per line). At least one required.
users.networks_needs_normalization: These networks aren't fully normalized/combined yet. Fix them or click the button.
users.selection_locked_hint: Prevent the user from changing category/service selections.
users.catalog_editable_hint: Allow the user to switch to a different catalog mode.
users.filter_editable_hint: Allow the user to edit their own allow/deny CIDRs via their account page.
users.filter_mode_hint: How user route filters interact with global filters.
users.no_selection: Select a user from the list or add a new one.
users.delete_confirm: Delete this user and all their settings?
users.error_networks: At least one client network is required.
users.credentials_not_needed: No credentials needed for this authentication method.
users.filter_fields_hidden: Set filter mode to Append or Override to configure allowed/denied CIDRs.
users.catalog_editable_hidden: Not available when selections are locked.
dashboard.no_history: No historical data yet. Data will appear as changes occur.

debug.cidr_hint: Enter a CIDR prefix or IP address to analyze (e.g., 10.0.0.0/8 or 192.168.1.1).
debug.no_results: Enter a CIDR prefix and click Analyze.
error.generic_message: An unexpected error occurred. Please try reloading the page.

user.filters_hint_allow: CIDR prefixes or single IPs to allow. One per line. Empty = allow all.
